name: TechWedali
name_zh: 深圳市伟达立创新科技有限公司
summary: TechWedali develops integrated robot joint modules and their drive, motor, encoder and transmission components. Founded in Shenzhen in 2024, the company was jointly established by Veichi Electric, Kedali and Shanghai Mirle. Its portfolio serves humanoid, collaborative, mobile and rehabilitation robots, with harmonic and planetary joint models documented in technical tables and additional component families under development or without published model specifications.
